entries.heading: Section 7605(b) of the Agriculture Improvement Act of
ancestors: DIVISION A—AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2021
entries.text:
Sec. 782.  Section 7605(b) of the Agriculture Improvement Act of 
2018 (7 U.S.C. 5940 note; Public Law 115-334) is amended by striking 
``September 30, 2021'' and inserting ``January 1, 2022''.
